newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Squabble blocks Brazil mortgage debt plan - paper.
newsitem.headline: Squabble blocks Brazil mortgage debt plan - paper.

text.p: A squabble between federal bank Caixa Economica and the National Treasury over who should owe up to 2.5 billion reais in old housing debt is blocking efforts to securitize some 50 billion reais in overdue mortgage debt, Gazeta Mercantil reported.
"The chance of putting this (2.5 billion reais debt) on Caixa Economica books is very remote. The debt is the Treasury's and not ours," Caixa President Sergio Cutolo told the newspaper.
The 2.5 billion reais debt was held by the now defunct National Housing Bank and the National Treasury thinks the debt should be transferred to the Caixa.
The dispute is seen hindering efforts to securitize about 50 billion in old housing debt held by a federal fund known as the FCVS that provided housing loans to low-income Brazilians.
